perturbation.description: one realisation of the pick uncertainty of a surface in time (written by the ensemble for each member, STX-TN-16 section 3)

burial.description: Stage 4B: porosity at the maximum burial in the fault block (default) or column-wise in the restored frame (stage 2D).

fault_systems.description: Stage 4B (STX-TN-15 sections 2.1 to 2.3): polygonal fault networks, flower structures and duplexes, expanded into ordinary faults before typing.

linking.description: Stage 4B: the connecting fault of a breached relay, generated; it has no slip of its own.

watertight.description: Stage 4A (C27): largest distance from a horizon edge to the fault, horizon or boundary that ends it (default half the surface grid spacing).

pillars.description: Stage 4B: vertical pillars for dense intersecting fault networks (faults stair-stepped across cells).

geostatistics.description: stage 4D: properties simulated by geostatistics in geological-time coordinates (STX-TN-17 section 1)

variogram.description: a standardised variogram (sill 1): nugget plus nested structures (STX-TN-17 section 1.2)
a standardised variogram (sill 1): nugget plus nested structures (STX-TN-17 section 1.2)

interpretation.description: stage 4C: pick and velocity uncertainty carried into depth (STX-TN-16 section 3)

method.description: Stage 4A: least squares (Levenberg-Marquardt with Broyden updates) or Bayesian sampling of the posterior (STX-TN-14 section 4).

sampler.description: Stage 4A: the affine-invariant ensemble sampler (conditioning.method: bayesian).

walkers.description: Even number of walkers, at least 4 and twice the number of parameters (default max(4 n, 16)).

thin.description: Every thin-th step is written as an ensemble member (default 10).

geophysics.description: Stage 4A (STX-TN-14 section 7): gravity and magnetic forward modelling on prisms; anomalies are contrasts against the background values.

cell.description: Prism size (m); default the voxel spacing or the largest extent / 64.

background_density.description: Density of every unit not listed (kg/m3).

background_susceptibility.description: Susceptibility of every unit not listed (SI).

gravity.description: Gravity stations (mGal) as delivered; their corrections are stated, none applied.

restoration.description: Stage 4B (STX-TN-15 section 4): volumetric restoration of the model to a horizon (decision 18) and the bed-length limit of C31.

backstripping.description: Stage 4B (STX-TN-15 section 4.4): tectonic subsidence by Airy or flexural backstripping of the burial history.

eroded_section.description: Stage 4B (STX-TN-15 section 4.5): eroded section at an unconformity from a porosity log against a normal compaction trend.

geobodies.description: Stage 4B (STX-TN-15 section 3.3): channel belts and lobes placed inside a unit in geological-time coordinates.

bodies.description: Stage 4B (STX-TN-15 section 1): bodies that cut across or fold over the stratigraphy, emplaced in age order on the faults' ordinal scale.

perturbation.description: one realisation of the layer's velocity uncertainty (written by the ensemble for each member, STX-TN-16 section 3)
